What science honestly does not know yet: the big open questions, where the evidence leans today, and how that lean has moved.

## How this system runs

**What it is.** What science honestly does not know yet: the big open questions, where the evidence leans today, and how that lean has moved.

**The loop it closes.** A weekly beat watches review and preprint feeds for each question, files new evidence on the entry and moves the lean only when graded evidence moves it, recording why.

**How it bootstraps.** It is a tenant of the platform ([ultrastable/ultrastable](https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable)): its manifest is registered there, this repository holds its code, and the platform builds this repository's `main` into its Worker.

**How it runs.** Cloudflare Worker `ultrastable-open-questions`, deployed from this repository's `main` by the Ultrastable platform at open-questions.ultrastable.org; Cloudflare Pages project `open-questions`, ultrastable/open-questions loop.yml (GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages). Work is taken, done, verified and recorded by the system's own loops on a clock; a session or a person only adds ideas.
<!-- how:end -->
